question_title: How many lawsuits will have been filed against the Trump Administration according to the JustSecurity tracker on August 31, 2026?
summary: The Just Security litigation tracker showed 900 cases on July 16, 2026 (question publication). Resolution is August 31, 2026, ~46 days later. The clean 2026 series (627 Feb 10 → 753 Apr 9 → 900 Jul 16) implies a recent growth rate of ~1.5 cases/day (earlier 2026 was ~2.17/day). Extrapolating 1.5/day over 46 days gives ~+69 → ~969. A scenario mixture (70% steady 1.5/day, 15% acceleration 2.3/day, 15% deceleration/consolidation 0.6/day, plus a 5% methodology recalibration jump reflecting the prior 708→627 recalibration) yields a median of ~969 with P10 931 / P90 1005. The lower bound 899.5 sits at the current level (unlikely to fall below barring consolidation); the upper bound 1099.5 is essentially unreachable at current rates (would require ~4.3/day).

It centered the forecast on the most recent 1.5/day rate rather than the contaminated earlier period. This is the correct treatment, not a contamination error.

**Probability**: My independent estimate matches the agent's. Current 900 + ~46 days × ~1.5/day ≈ 969 median. The scenario mixture (70% steady / 15% accel / 15% decel + 5% recal jump) appropriately widens both tails without distorting the center. P10 931 / P90 1005 is well-calibrated. No meaningful divergence.
